nodes.label: orchestrator-config.json
nodes.rationale: Single versioned, schema-validated, diffable JSON externalizing today's hardcoded classifier/risk/executor/routing; the Delamain-editable orchestrator deliverable.

nodes.label: Peer-Outcome Telemetry / Episode Ledger (peer-outcomes.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Missing learning signal: append one PeerOutcome record per terminal peer; must capture every terminal status or learning is biased.

nodes.label: MemoryStore service
nodes.rationale: Tagged Effect service with Live layer + test stub; server-side abstraction governing memory writes under kill-switch/budget policy.

nodes.label: Shared Basic Memory store
nodes.rationale: Operator-directed shared substrate every agent can read/write via ONE HTTP MCP server; backend RESOLVED to Basic Memory (local Markdown+SQLite+FastEmbed, git-auditable).

nodes.label: Motoko learning loop
nodes.rationale: Motoko reads telemetry+memory, reflects, and emits orchestrator-config cards through the human-gated MAPE-K close.

nodes.label: Typed proposal cards (HermesProposalCard)
nodes.rationale: Every improvement flows through a typed proposal card to explicit human approval to a versioned reversible change.

nodes.label: orchestrator-config actionKind
nodes.rationale: NEW approval-required action kind targeting the config itself; carries configDiff + sourceReflectionIds.

nodes.label: memory-write actionKind
nodes.rationale: NEW durable operator-memory item gated by Memory Review (approve/edit/discard).

nodes.label: AutomodePolicy
nodes.rationale: Kill-switch/allowlist/budget runtime safety authority kept deliberately OUTSIDE the self-editable config so a bad edit can never disable the kill switch.

nodes.label: Delamain peers
nodes.rationale: Execution substrate: codex/cursor peers in isolated worktrees, one slice each; the only execution substrate.

nodes.label: Automode dispatcher (AutomodeSupervisor)
nodes.rationale: Server-owned typed dispatcher; dispatchGoal spawns peers and is the hook point for monitorPeerOutcome telemetry.

nodes.label: delamain-autopilot (supervisor.py)
nodes.rationale: Cron supervisor over a TSV roadmap; its lint/tsc/test/build + forbidden-touch + patch-id gates are reused as the empirical fitness function.

nodes.label: Open GSD
nodes.rationale: Owns phase truth (.planning); Motoko proposes phase work but does not write .planning directly.

nodes.label: MAPE-K loop
nodes.rationale: Autonomic-computing closed loop (Monitor/Analyze/Plan/Execute/Knowledge) with the human placed at Analyze and Execute; the spine all four research streams converged on.

nodes.label: Reflections (confidence-scored heuristics)
nodes.rationale: Confidence-scored heuristics with trigger conditions written only by the consolidation job and decayed; these (not raw logs) become the evidence Motoko cites in cards.

nodes.label: External fitness/verification gates
nodes.rationale: Fitness stays external (real lint/tsc/test/build + forbidden-touch + patch-id); Motoko must never grade its own proposals (Self-Refine plateau).

nodes.label: Append-only versioned config archive + rollback
nodes.rationale: Immutable config-v{n}.json with lineage and one-click rollback; the safe subset adopted from Darwin-Godel/SICA archives.

nodes.label: Four-axis memory scoping
nodes.rationale: Every entry tagged operatorId/repoSlug/engine/runId; the one durable mem0 idea that survived verification, adopted at the contract level regardless of backend.

nodes.label: approvalMode=smart bandit ranker
nodes.rationale: Preference/contextual-bandit scorer ranks/pre-filters/auto-defers low-confidence cards, never auto-approves; auto-approval reintroduces silent self-modification.

nodes.label: skill-creator self-improvement engine
nodes.rationale: Create/Eval/Improve/Benchmark engine wired to GitsSkillInventory; rewrites SKILL.md and reruns >=3 evals before write-back.

nodes.label: Voyager-style verified recipe library
nodes.rationale: Library of verified vertical-slice prompts/configs admitted only after verification gates pass.

nodes.label: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
nodes.rationale: Supervisor substrate inside apps/server; exposes hooks/subagents/MCP/skills; PreToolUse hooks enforce kill-switch fail-closed.

nodes.label: Native Claude memory tool (Motoko private scratch)
nodes.rationale: Retained separately as Motoko's private reasoning scratch, distinct from the shared cross-agent store; do not conflate.
nodes.norm_label: native claude memory tool (motoko private scratch)

nodes.label: Graphiti (temporal-KG upgrade)
nodes.rationale: Named temporal upgrade behind the same MemoryStore seam; automatic temporal invalidation but Python-only OSS core and single group_id per MCP search.

nodes.label: mem0
nodes.rationale: Rejected as backend: OSS v3 dropped auto-consolidation (single-pass ADD-only), hosted graph is Pro-only/off-device; only four-axis scoping survives.

nodes.label: Letta / MemGPT
nodes.rationale: Mature shared-block model but is an MCP host/client only, not a native MCP server; cross-tool sharing rides a fragile third-party bridge.

nodes.label: memorix
nodes.rationale: TypeScript-native dark-horse with worktree-isolation model mirroring Delamain; held back by maturity/bus-factor.

nodes.label: agentmemory
nodes.rationale: Closest by intent (shared cross-coding-agent store, scope flag, 4-tier consolidation + Ebbinghaus decay) but pre-1.0/single-maintainer; revisit post-1.0.

nodes.label: Augment Intent
nodes.rationale: Coordinator->Implementor->Verifier over a living spec with 3 human checkpoints, isolated worktree per Implementor, parallel waves; exactly Delamain's shape.

nodes.label: Augment Cosmos
nodes.rationale: Org-level agent OS that Intent sits within (public preview May 2026); Intent was NOT renamed to Cosmos.

nodes.label: Augment Learning Flywheel
nodes.rationale: Execute->Coach->Distill->Improve turns human corrections into distilled heuristics with trigger conditions; the exact shape of a Motoko reflection + config card.

nodes.label: Augment Memory Review
nodes.rationale: Auto-proposed memories become human-reviewable/editable/discardable before save after fully-automatic version caused low-quality pile-up; adopted as pending->approve/edit/discard.

nodes.label: BerriAI propose-then-approve config edits
nodes.rationale: Exact-match diff (originalSnippet appears exactly once) propose-then-approve config-edit governance anchor borrowed into OrchestratorConfigDiff.

nodes.label: Maestro (arXiv:2509.04642)
nodes.rationale: Jointly optimizes orchestrator graph + per-module config against a fitness signal via reflective textual trace feedback; but auto-applies (no human card/gate).

nodes.label: Darwin-Godel Machine (arXiv:2505.22954)
nodes.rationale: Benchmark-as-fitness + append-only archive + iterative artifact edits raise capability; its own 'may behave destructively' safety notes justify GITS's gate.

nodes.label: SICA (arXiv:2504.15228)
nodes.rationale: Self-improving coding agent; sound self-improvement engine (SWE-bench 20->50%) but autonomous self-rewrite; GITS adopts only the archive+rollback+empirical-fitness subset.

nodes.label: EvoAgentX + HITLManager
nodes.rationale: Evolves workflow structure + prompts WITH a HITLManager/HITLInterceptorAgent; rare two-pillar (evolve + gate) confirmation; gates at action/tool-call level.

nodes.label: HumanLayer
nodes.rationale: Popular dedicated approval primitive (~11k stars); borrow async approval UX rather than reinvent; gates per-call (vs GITS at config-version-promotion).

nodes.label: Ruflo / Claude-Flow
nodes.rationale: Closest surface (swarm + shared memory + 'self-learning') but 'SONA self-improvement' is RAG-of-past-trajectories with no governed config change/gate; the anti-pattern GITS's versioned/diffable/approved config is the antidote to.

nodes.label: OpenHands / OpenDevin
nodes.rationale: Strong executor with immutable event-stream architecture; no self-improvement/declarative routing/HITL in core; borrow the immutable event ledger from day 1.

nodes.label: Kilo Code
nodes.rationale: GITS's substrate done in an IDE: agent-per-git-worktree, diff-vs-parent review panel; no strategist/self-improvement; borrow the diff panel + AGENTS.md portable memory.

nodes.label: DSPy
nodes.rationale: The honest self-improving: offline compilation of prompts/demos against a user metric, inspectable artifact; borrow metric-as-first-class-input + inspectable/diffable artifact.

nodes.label: GEPA
nodes.rationale: Reflective Pareto prompt evolution; borrow Pareto multi-objective fitness - keep pass-rate, cost, forbidden-touch separate, never one scalar.

nodes.label: Microsoft Trace (OptoPrime)
nodes.rationale: 'AutoDiff for agents'; rich feedback (errors/NL/scores) not a scalar reward drives edits; feed Motoko the full episode record, not just a status.

nodes.label: AgentEvolver
nodes.rationale: Training-time RL + self-attribution/credit-assignment; borrow credit-assignment (attribute episode outcome to config choices) not the RL.

nodes.label: MetaGPT
nodes.rationale: SOP-as-orchestration but code-baked + static; validates explicit-process > model-brilliance, but GITS makes it a versioned evolvable artifact.

nodes.label: LangGraph
nodes.rationale: General agent graph, no worktree isolation/self-improvement; LangGraph checkpoint + interrupt-for-approval is the canonical HITL pattern to borrow.

nodes.label: GITS empty-quadrant composition
nodes.rationale: No OSS repo combines worktree-isolated parallel peers + self-improvement loop + editable/diffable orchestration-config + human approval gate; GITS is novel in composition, not in any single component.

nodes.label: T3 Code shell
nodes.rationale: Remote IDE shell GITS forks: remote access, clients, provider sessions, terminal streaming, pairing, Tailscale, SSH launch.

nodes.label: DevOS Cockpit
nodes.rationale: Owns projects, repos, milestones, .planning state, GSD phases, verification gates, UAT evidence, queue/resource/cost visibility, Your Turn cards.

nodes.label: Automation order (observable->control->automation)
nodes.rationale: Observable state first, control second, automation last; Milestone 1 stays read-only; preserved by the self-improvement phased roadmap.

nodes.label: packages/contracts/src/gits.ts
nodes.rationale: Shared Effect schemas / RPC contracts where GITS domain contracts and the new OrchestratorConfig + extended proposal card live.

nodes.label: Motoko (Hermes operator profile)
nodes.rationale: GITS-owned operator profile on the Hermes runtime; observe/propose-only strategist that reasons, remembers, briefs, and produces proposal cards.

nodes.label: Hermes runtime
nodes.rationale: Nous Research Hermes agent runtime accessed via fixed CLI args under isolated HERMES_HOME; supports ACP, MCP, profile distributions, scheduled automations.

nodes.label: ACP (Agent/Client Protocol)
nodes.rationale: Preferred first-class editor/agent integration exposing chat, tool activity, diffs, terminal, approval prompts, streamed responses over stdio.

nodes.label: Capacity-aware router (GitsCapacityMonitor)
nodes.rationale: Formats a provider-capacity snapshot (Codex/Cursor budgets) and recommends a Delamain engine; Hermes may only propose routing, GITS+Delamain own execution.

nodes.label: Observe/propose-only policy
nodes.rationale: Motoko must not merge/force-push/run destructive shell or use YOLO mode; approval mode must be manual or smart; repo writes handed to Delamain; human approval required before integrate/merge/destructive/write-shaped proposals.

nodes.label: GitsSkillInventory / Skills Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Native cockpit surface inventorying Codex/Claude/Cursor skills read-only, adding reviews/ratings/usage telemetry and a HERMES improvement candidate queue (488 skills, 40 Hermes candidates).

nodes.label: HERMES improvement loop/queue
nodes.rationale: HERMES starts as a proposal engine not an auto file editor; enqueue->generate proposal->show diff->explicit approval before writeback.

nodes.label: RTK output gateway
nodes.rationale: Conservative, opt-in, provider-aware output gateway; separates post-execution display compaction from true provider-token savings (rewrite before tool runs).

nodes.label: Claude canUseTool command rewriting
nodes.rationale: Claude's canUseTool interception is the only path that reduces provider model tokens by rewriting Bash inputs with rtk rewrite before allowing the tool.

nodes.label: GITS Tailnet hosting (gits-cockpit.service)
nodes.rationale: WSL user systemd service on loopback 127.0.0.1:13773, fronted by Windows Tailscale Serve on :8443 tailnet-only; deploy worktree hard-reset to origin/gits with build-info provenance.

nodes.label: build-info provenance (/api/gits/build-info)
nodes.rationale: Exposes active branch/commit/build time/dirty/source path; Overview tab renders the same provenance so stale hosting is visible immediately.
